added.IMKkcn: Heads up, removing your Passkey means your account will no longer require Multi-Factor Authentication to sign in. If you have not reached out to Discord support for help with removing your Passkey and someone reached out to you instead, back out and report them. Discord support will never contact you first in a direct message.

Discord support will never contact you first in a direct message.
